name: env-preflight
question: Does this environment have the capabilities the project's development requires (git, JSON parser, build tooling, optional device/browser probes)?
cost_provenance: measured 2026-07-20 on the ULDF framework repo (no Android markers) under Git Bash (win32; slowest supported environment): 3 runs 1053-1146ms (binary-presence `command -v` probes; every conditional probe is file-existence-gated). Declared 1800ms is honest for the common (non-mobile) path, below the 2000ms fast-lane ceiling (ORACLE-COST-01). The bounded (2s-capped) adb device probe fires ONLY on Android-marker projects; on those the runner's auto-demotion (ORACLE-COST-03) is the safety net. The prior 2500ms declared the mobile worst-case as expected AND kept lane:fast -- self-contradictory (>2000ms is a fast-lane violation).

schema.ok: boolean (false when >=1 critical capability is unavailable)

checks.name: string (git | json-parser | python | node | playwright | adb)
checks.fix: string (one-line remediation; empty when status=available or not-applicable)

schema.critical_failures: integer (count of checks with critical=true and status=unavailable)
schema.briefing: string (empty when ok=true; one-liner suitable for a briefing line when a critical capability is missing)

fallback: Probe manually: `git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` (critical); a working JSON parser (`jq --version`, else `python -c "import json"` -- beware the Windows Store python stub, PW-005: the binary exists but exits non-zero on `-c pass`); if package.json exists, `node --version` (critical for build); if playwright.config.* exists, check node_modules/playwright or node_modules/@playwright is installed; if the project has Android markers (android/ dir, AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle), `adb devices` shows a connected device/emulator. Any critical capability missing means autonomous execution will fail mid-run -- fix before starting.

provenance.note: Replaces the hand-rolled 239-line agentic preflight probe in segments/-ltads/start_preflight.md (scrutiny 04 F17/ADD-3; Enforcement Placement section 1: code can enforce it). start_preflight.md is now a thin invoker over this oracle; `/0-uldf-ltads-start --preflight` and Phase -2 consume it. Read-only by contract (ORACULURGY_DESIGN.md Part 11 sec 11.3.4). Conditional probes are project-marker-gated so non-web/non-mobile projects pay only the universal checks.

config.comment: Marker sets gate the conditional probes. Keep aligned with run.sh / run.ps1 (the scripts hardcode the same defaults for the <2s speed contract).
